To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
postoperative patient plasmas contain a factor(s) in the 30- to 100-kD MW range that stimulates PAI-I synthesis and secretion by HUVEC.

the postoperative increase of PAI- 1 is contributed to not only by an increase in plasma PAI- 11 but also by a postoperative plasma factor(s) that stimulate endothelial PAI- 111 biosynthesis in vitro and in vivo.

postoperative patient serum contains a factor(s), in a molecular weight range of approximately 20-100 Kd, that stimulates endothelial cell PA1-1 biosynthesis and may mediate postoperative thrombotic complications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the endothelial cell type 1 plasminogen inhibitor (PAI-I) in the pathophysiology of postoperative fibrinolysis.
the regulation of fibrinolysis and thrombosis, two important aspects of the hemostatic system.
the regulation of the plasminogen system and its role in thrombosis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
postoperative fibrilolytic shutdown is a complex process involving multiple factors that stimulate PAI-1 expression by endothelial cells and other cell types.
postoperative fibrino-lytic shutdown is mediated in part by plasma factor(s) which stimulate endothelial cell biosynthesis of type I PAI-1.

postoperative fibrilolytic shutdown is not caused by an increased production of PAI- 1 in the liver, but is caused by an increased synthesis of PAI- in the vascular endothelial cells, which is induced by plasma factors that are produced in response to the surgery.

postoperative patient fibrinolysis is regulated in part by a plasma mediator that induces vascular endothelium PAI-1 expression and secretion.
postoperative plasma contains an unidentified factor(s) in a 30-100 kDa MW range which stimulates PAI- 1 synthesis and secretion in cultured HUVECs.

postoperative fibrilolytic shutdown is due to a plasma factor that stimulates PAI1 synthesis and secretion from endothelial cells.
